displayIdentity.body: Wilderness Israel becomes warning and includes the plague number. Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea; No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
